encounter.notes: Ornate bone/ivory Dwemer-style construct: tall crested helm with a halo ring behind the head, filigree wing-like pauldrons, engraved chest plate, segmented waist, dark leather shorts, ornate thigh/knee plates and greaves, clawed gauntlets.

side_plates.note: No true left/right profile is published. No profile was synthesized; fabricated detail is not permitted.

registration.note: Listed before the torso plate so the torso wins in the overlap; the engine has no region gate for non-head closeups, only list order plus frame feather.

closeups.rejected_reason: MISREGISTERED despite the lowest width error of any plate (3.65%). The overlay shows greaves, boots and gauntlets doubled with a ~25px offset. Width error alone is not sufficient evidence; the overlay is.

head-region fit returned 11.38% because the closeup has no shoulders in frame, so its own shoulder detection fell back and the seeded scale window (0.533-1.189) excluded the true scale of ~0.455. A wide manual sweep reaches 4.75%, but that overlay still shows the flanking halo rings doubled by ~3%, which would blur exactly the features the closeup exists to sharpen.
three-quarter front-left capture, not a front-axis plate; projecting it as front would smear
head-region width error 37.21%; overlay shows the halo ring grossly oversized
head-region width error 39.76%; features do not correspond

geometry.provenance: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2mv (hunyuan3d-dit-v2-mv, fp16, 50 steps, octree 380, seed 12345) from view-01/view-03 only. Draft: 378,032 faces, 2 shells, 0 boundary edges, 79.5s on an RTX 4070 Ti Super.

regions.note: Shoulder detector returned 0.7841 (front) / 0.7984 (back) and was verified visually against the plate: the line sits at the pauldron top and keeps the whole helm and halo inside the head band. 0.78 is used so both views are comfortably covered.

uv_density.note: Tuned for this silhouette: the crested helm plus halo ring is a far larger share of the body than a normal head, so it needs much LESS boost than Vrol (5.5) or Yandir (8.0). head_scale 5.5 overshot to 321^2 with the head taking 38.5% of the atlas; 2.0 lands ~258^2 at ~25%.
